name: bbc-tariffs
title: What are tariffs, how do they work and why is Trump using them?

knownGaps.why: Editorial prose is not a price column. A single finance article names a GBP5 monthly bill and a GBP7bn debt in the same paragraph, and no page-wide decimal count can render both: the bill needs three decimals to be nonzero, the debt needs none. The rule is right for a shop shelf and structurally unreachable for a news article.

A settlement or a valuation genuinely is billions of fiat, which is tens or hundreds of millions of ZEC. The digits are not a formatting mistake, they are the number. The open question is whether a figure at this scale should convert at all rather than how to shorten it.
